title: Token Budget Constraint
description: Resource constraint for a Work Packet. Sibling to must_not_modify and required_validation — a constraint, not an authority. Violations route through the same disposition pipeline as scope violations. Token budget originates at the LINK planning layer (or falls back to estimator p80 for auto-generated packets), not at the runtime. The agent receives a constraint. It does not decide the constraint.

planned.description: Token budget authorized by LINK planning. Informed by CostEstimate but set by human judgment — may exceed or undercut any percentile based on risk tolerance, deadline pressure, or scope confidence. For auto-generated Work Packets (ad-hoc CLI execution), falls back to the CostEstimate's p80 value.

tolerance.description: Multiplier on planned before checkpoint trigger. 1.25 = 25% headroom. Accounts for execution variance without hard cutoff. The checkpoint fires at planned * tolerance, not at planned.

checkpoint_at_pct.description: Percentage of (planned * tolerance) at which checkpoint is triggered. Default 90% leaves room for graceful wrap-up. At checkpoint: agent stops, emits evidence, disposition pipeline decides.

type.description: checkpoint: agent stops, emits evidence, disposition pipeline decides (continue, reduce scope, accept partial, or stop). escalate: owner review required. There is no 'kill' or 'terminate' option — budget exhaustion is governed, not terminal.

estimate_ref.description: CostEstimate observation_id that informed this budget. Traceability link from the Work Packet back to the estimation evidence.
